> Source: NetApp's **ontap-mcp** API catalog for **ONTAP 9.16** (github.com/NetApp/ontap-mcp, Apache-2.0, see NOTICE.md). It lists **GET endpoints only**, with their filters and fields. ## GET `/api/storage/aggregates`

**Tier:** T0 · **since ONTAP** 9.6

Retrieves the collection of aggregates for the entire cluster. ### Expensive properties There is an added computational cost to retrieving values for these properties. They are not included by default

**Fields** (request with `fields=a,b.c`):

| Field | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `block_storage` |  | Configuration information for the locally attached portion of the aggregate. When a cloud store is also used by this aggregate, this is referred to as the performance tier. |
| `cloud_storage` |  | Configuration information for the cloud storage portion of the aggregate. This is referred to as the capacity tier. |
| `create_time` |  | Timestamp of aggregate creation. |
| `dr_home_node` |  | Node where the aggregate resides after disaster recovery. The value for this field might differ from the 'node' field during switchover. |
| `home_node` |  | Node where the aggregate resides after giveback. The value for this field might differ from the value of the 'node' field during takeover. |
| `is_spare_low` | 9.11 | Specifies whether the aggregate is in a spares low condition on any of the RAID groups. This is an advanced property; there is an added computational cost to retrieving its value. The field is not populated for either… |
| `metric` | 9.7 | The most recent sample of I/O metrics for the aggregate. |
| `name` |  | Aggregate name. |
| `node` |  | Node where the aggregate currently resides. |
| `sidl_enabled` | 9.11 | Specifies whether or not SIDL is enabled on the aggregate. |
| `snaplock_type` |  | SnapLock type. |
| `state` |  | Operational state of the aggregate. |
| `statistics` | 9.7 | The real time I/O statistics for the aggregate. |
| `uuid` |  | Aggregate UUID. |
| `volume-count` | 9.11 | Number of volumes in the aggregate. |

| Filter | Type | Since | Description |

| `qos_policy` |  |  |  |
| `schedule.name` |  |  |  |
| `start_threshold_percent` | integer |  |  |

| `svm.uuid` |  |  |  |
| `type` |  |  |  |
| `uuid` |  |  |  |

**Fields** (request with `fields=a,b.c`):

| Field | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `comment` |  | A comment associated with the volume efficiency policy. |
| `duration` |  | This field is used with the policy type "scheduled" to indicate the allowed duration for a session, in hours. Possible value is a number between 0 and 999 inclusive. Default is unlimited indicated by value 0. |
| `enabled` |  | Is the volume efficiency policy enabled? |
| `name` |  | Name of the volume efficiency policy. |
| `qos_policy` |  | QoS policy for the sis operation. Possible values are background and best_effort. In background, sis operation will run in background with minimal or no impact on data serving client operations. In best_effort, sis… |
| `start_threshold_percent` |  | This field is used with the policy type "threshold" to indicate the threshold percentage for triggering the volume efficiency policy. It is mutually exclusive of the schedule. |
| `svm` |  | SVM, applies only to SVM-scoped objects. |
| `type` |  | Type of volume efficiency policy. |
| `uuid` |  | Unique identifier of volume efficiency policy. |

## GET `/api/storage/volumes/{volume.uuid}/snapshots`

**Tier:** T0 · **since ONTAP** 9.6

Retrieves a collection of volume snapshots. ### Expensive properties There is an added computational cost to retrieving the amount of reclaimable space for snapshots, as the calculation is done on dem

## GET `/api/storage/volumes/{volume.uuid}/snapshots/{uuid}`

**Tier:** T0 · **since ONTAP** 9.6
